stories.author: Judd Legum
stories.title: Trump’s new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, claims she’s a lawyer. Is she?
stories.text: When President Trump plucked Katie Zacharia from obscurity and appointed her as his new press secretary, he called her “an attorney.” This is also how Zacharia, repeatedly and publicly, describes herself. “ I’m a lawyer ,” Zacharia said during an appearance on the Greg Kelly Show on October 5, 2026. “ [A]s a lawyer , the procedural steps are absolutely critical,” Zacharia opined during the August 31, 2026, edition of Fox & Friends First. “ I’m a lawyer, I went to Pepperdine, Pepperdine Law ,” Zacharia said on the “In Front of Us” podcast on August 14, 2026. “ [A]s a lawyer , there’s a big difference between answering something under oath and answering something to the media,” Zacharia explained on CNN on February 7, 2026. There are many more examples. Zacharia was also identified on screen as a lawyer during at least 18 appearances on Fox News since March 2025. Yet, there is no evidence that Zacharia ever passed a bar exam or has been admitted to practice law in any state. She is not listed as a member of the State Bar of California , the state where she lives. stories.title: Sheldon Whitehouse’s Day One Plan For A Post-Trump Presidency
stories.text: It’s day one after President Donald Trump leaves office; a Democrat has been elected to replace him, and there are four years of Trump’s mess to clean up — what should the new president do? Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse (D-R.I.) has a plan: Prepare in advance to eradicate Trump’s influence across the executive branch, even if it means using presidential power “to its fullest.” Then, he says, comes the harder task of rebuilding a government that gets things done while playing by the rules. In this premium bonus episode of Master Plan: The Kingmakers , we’re sharing David Sirota’s full interview with Whitehouse. The senator gives his thoughts on the Justice Department, regulatory agencies, the Supreme Court, and where the limits of presidential power should be. stories.text: In this week’s episode of The War Brief, we discuss U.S. President Donald Trump considering new strikes on Iran and how that highlights the numerous setbacks he is facing in the region, from Iran increasing imposing its will on the Strait of Hormuz, to the Ansarallah (Houthis) in Yemens consolidating their control on Bab al-Mandab, and the emergency withdrawal of American B1B bombers from the UK. We are then joined by Drop Site contributor Bonzer Barry to break down the latest in military developments in Yemen. Later on I am joined by Dr. Shahryar Pasandideh , who argues that the withdrawal of the bombers from the UK is more consequential than it appears.
